title: Keep the latest record
description: One customer. One current source of truth.
intro: Exports overlap. Customers change. Build a clean customer table that retains only the most recent record for each customer, using the source update time.
objectives: Create silver_customers with one row per customer_id.
Use BIGINT IDs, trimmed names, lowercase emails, and TIMESTAMP update times.
Keep the record with the latest updated_at for each customer.
Return only customer_id, name, email, and updated_at.
hints: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) ranks each customer’s records.
Filter a ranked CTE to rn = 1, or use QUALIFY. Rank after converting types.
solutionExplanation: Clean and type the records first, then rank each customer's updates from newest to oldest. QUALIFY keeps only row number 1, leaving one current record per customer.
